npcs.name: Mallam Ryon
npcs.greet: I speak for the masters of this House, who cannot be bothered to speak for themselves. You may consider that an honour. They would.

npcs.name: Master Aryon
npcs.greet: Most of my colleagues think the world ends at the edge of their towers. I am trying to persuade them otherwise. It is slow work.

npcs.name: Mistress Dratha
npcs.greet: Stand further back. Further. There. Men are tolerable at a distance, and you are not yet tolerable.

npcs.name: Divayth Fyr
npcs.greet: Four thousand years, and visitors still knock as though I might be asleep. I am never asleep. Come in, and touch nothing.

npcs.name: Feldras Morvayn
npcs.greet: A tower is not built, it is persuaded to grow. Bring me patience and spores, and I'll give you a home.

npcs.name: Archmagister Gothren
npcs.greet: The Council needs no new voices. The Council needs fewer. Leave my tower while you still have legs.

relics.name: Jar of Netch Jelly
relics.desc: Quivering, faintly glowing jelly from a bull netch. A Telvanni master wanted it for reasons he did not explain.

relics.name: Raw Glass Lode
relics.desc: Green, glittering raw glass from the Zebabi mine. Worth more than its weight in gold, and heavy enough to prove it.

relics.name: Tower Spores
relics.desc: A sealed pouch of Telvanni tower spores, ready to be coaxed into a mushroom tower.

relics.name: Divayth Fyr's Endorsement
relics.desc: A single line in Divayth Fyr's hand: 'Not a fool.' From him, this is a lavish recommendation.

tv_council: The Telvanni Council House is a forest of grown stone and silence. The masters sit far apart, each pretending the others are not there.
My new Mouth will speak for me today. Listen, or don't. You usually don't.
At least this one has some manners. More than the last.
tv_archmagister: Gothren falls among his own enchanted pillars. The tower of Tel Aruhn shudders once, and is still.
By Telvanni law, the strong rule. Gothren refused to step aside. Now he has, permanently. Archmagister, the Council awaits you, mostly with resentment.

quests.title: A Hireling's Errand
quests.offer: I want to join House Telvanni.
quests.pitch: You and every other hopeful who can light a candle with a thought. Very well. A master requires jelly from a bull netch, fresh. Kill one, bring the jar, and do not drop it. The last hireling dropped it.
quests.desc: Mallam Ryon, who speaks for the masters at the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora, will accept me as a hireling if I fetch a jar of fresh netch jelly for one of the masters.

objectives.text: Hunt a bull netch outside Sadrith Mora
Bring the netch jelly to Mallam Ryon
objectives.reply: Remarkable. You may call yourself a hireling of House Telvanni. Do not call yourself anything grander in front of a master. They are very easily bored, and boredom makes them creative.

quests.outro: I joined House Telvanni as a hireling. The masters do not know my name yet. Mallam Ryon assures me this is a blessing.

quests.title: The Raw Glass Bargain
quests.offer: Mallam Ryon says you have work, Mistress.
quests.pitch: I have a contract for raw glass from the Zebabi mine. The miners now say a Hlaalu agent has bought the lode out from under me. I want my glass, and I want the agent to understand what it means to cheat a Telvanni.
quests.desc: Mistress Dratha's raw glass contract with the Zebabi mine has been undercut by a Hlaalu agent. She wants her glass, and she wants the agent to regret it.

objectives.text: Travel to the Zebabi glass mine
Deal with the Hlaalu agent's hired guards

objectives.journal: The Hlaalu agent ran when his guards fell. He left the glass, a half-eaten lunch, and a contract worth three times what Dratha was paying.

objectives.text: Bring the raw glass to Mistress Dratha
objectives.topic: Your glass, Mistress. The Hlaalu agent won't be back.
objectives.reply: Hmph. Adequate. More than adequate. You may approach to within five paces from now on. Do not let it go to your head.

quests.outro: I recovered Mistress Dratha's raw glass from the Zebabi mine. She allowed me to stand five paces closer, which I am told is unprecedented.

quests.title: Growing Tel Uvirith
quests.offer: Is there work worthy of a Telvanni, Master Aryon?
quests.pitch: Every Telvanni of standing has a tower. You will need one, if you want anyone to take you seriously. There is a site in the Molag Amur called Uvirith. Take these spores, clear the ground, and find Feldras Morvayn. He grows the best towers in the House.
quests.desc: Master Aryon has given me tower spores to grow my own Telvanni mushroom tower, Tel Uvirith, in the Molag Amur.

objectives.text: Travel to the site of Tel Uvirith
Banish the daedra a rival wizard bound to the site
objectives.journal: Someone had bound daedra to guard the site before I arrived. Feldras says that is a Telvanni's way of saying 'I was here first.'

objectives.text: Give the spores to Feldras Morvayn
objectives.topic: Master Aryon sent me with these spores.
objectives.reply: Fine spores. Healthy. Give me a day, and some quiet, and I'll show you something worth living in.

objectives.journal: By the next evening a pale stalk taller than three men stood where the spores went in, and Feldras was humming to it.

quests.outro: Tel Uvirith has begun to grow in the Molag Amur. In a Telvanni's eyes, I am now someone with a house.

quests.title: A Mouth at Council
quests.desc: Master Aryon wants me to speak for him at the Telvanni Council as his Mouth. The masters will not listen without an endorsement from someone they fear, and no one frightens them like Divayth Fyr.

objectives.text: Ask Divayth Fyr for an endorsement
objectives.topic: Master Aryon asks that you vouch for me before the Council.
objectives.reply: Does he? One of my experiments has walked out of its cell and is sulking in the lower hall. Put it back. Permanently is fine.

objectives.journal: It had been a storm atronach once. Fyr had changed something about it. I didn't ask.

objectives.topic: Your experiment won't trouble you again.
objectives.reply: Good. Take this to the Council. It says exactly what I think of you, which is more than I say of most.

objectives.text: Present the endorsement at the Council House
objectives.reply: 'Not a fool.' Gods, he's never written that about me. Come. The Council is sitting.

objectives.text: Speak for Master Aryon at the Council

choices.label: Propose that the House trade openly with the Empire.
choices.reply: Boldly done. Half of them hissed, which means they listened. Aryon looks delighted.

choices.label: Insist that no Telvanni bends the knee to Imperial law.
choices.reply: They nodded. Even Gothren nodded. Aryon looks pained, but you won the room.

quests.outro: I spoke for Master Aryon before the Telvanni Council as his Mouth, carrying Divayth Fyr's endorsement.

quests.title: By Telvanni Law
quests.desc: Mistress Sedura Sarano, who bound daedra to the site of Tel Uvirith, has sent assassins after me since the Council session. By Telvanni law, a wizard may answer such an insult in kind.

objectives.text: Ask Master Aryon about the attacks
objectives.topic: Someone keeps sending assassins after me.
objectives.reply: Sedura Sarano. She wanted Uvirith and lost it to you. Telvanni law permits you to settle the matter at her tower. Few would blame you. Fewer would mourn her.

objectives.journal: Sedura Sarano died believing I would never dare. In House Telvanni, that is the most common last thought.

objectives.topic: Sedura Sarano won't trouble me again.
objectives.reply: Then you have done what every master of this House has done at least once. Now there is only one obstacle left between you and the Council's highest seat.

quests.outro: By Telvanni law, I settled my quarrel with Mistress Sedura Sarano at her own tower.

quests.title: Archmagister
quests.desc: Archmagister Gothren has refused to recognize me as a master. Master Aryon says there is only one Telvanni answer: go to Tel Aruhn and take the seat.

objectives.topic: The Council will recognise me, Gothren, or it will need a new Archmagister.
objectives.reply: Recognise you? I'll have you made into a lamp. Guards!

quests.outro: I defeated Gothren at Tel Aruhn and took his seat. I am Archmagister of House Telvanni.
